summary: Reconciled the final 0.2.0 pre-publish documentation and reran the repository, package, built-artifact, focused reliability/privacy, benchmark and registry gates. Existing Batch 013–015 exact rc.1 source-built/local-packed evidence remains valid, while this batch records external blockers for a new live browser/host run and Draft PR creation.

tests.name: task contract validation
tests.evidence: node .agent-workflow/validator/validate-contract.mjs task docs/agent-tasks/ACTIVE_TASK.json -> VALID TASK CONTRACT

tests.name: npm ci
tests.evidence: 238 packages installed; npm reported existing audit advisories and allowScripts warnings only

tests.name: typecheck/build
tests.evidence: npm run typecheck and npm run build passed for both workspaces

tests.name: full repository tests
tests.evidence: npm test: vision 63 passed, image-mind 325 passed with 8 intentional skips, root 57 passed

tests.name: package and built-artifact tests
tests.evidence: npm run test:package 11 passed; npm run test:built 6 passed

tests.name: focused reliability/browser/privacy regression sweep
tests.evidence: 45 files, 222 tests passed across provider reliability/fallback, execution gate, retry, cache/refocus, routing, attachment/restart, SSRF, RPC, lifecycle, telemetry and UI privacy seams

tests.name: deterministic 100-case benchmark
tests.evidence: 100 cases; routing/task/assertion success 100%; forbiddenHitCount 0; trace/route/token coverage 100%; evidence-cache reuse 20%; controlled baseline comparison passed

tests.name: aspect/pixel-aware preprocessing comparison
tests.evidence: npm run benchmark:preprocess passed for both long fixtures; current 8192 policy preserved more horizontal resolution and row-order evidence

tests.name: registry preflight
tests.evidence: npm view for both 0.2.0 packages returned E404; recorded EXPECTED_NOT_PUBLISHED without publish or metadata mutation

tests.name: npm pack dry-run
tests.evidence: vision 0.2.0 contained lib/types/README; image-mind 0.2.0 contained lib/patch/README only; no src/tests/credentials

tests.name: exact rc.1 source-built/local-packed evidence from merged Batches 013–015
tests.evidence: Prior durable Result Contracts 013–015 record exact @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.1 official add/boot/local-stub smoke/browser seams/official remove using task-owned local-packed 0.2.0 artifacts

tests.name: Batch 016 live exact rc.1 browser/host repeat
tests.evidence: Task-owned launcher/profile was prepared, but the only detected listener on port 3080 belonged to a pre-existing dsh-official-runtime process outside task-owned state; it was not touched, and no browser result from that process is claimed

tests.name: Draft PR creation
tests.evidence: Branch was pushed; installed gh client reported no authenticated GitHub session and could not create a PR without interactive credentials

tests.name: git diff --check and security audit
tests.evidence: No whitespace errors, personal machine paths, credential material or secret-bearing values in changed docs/result

blockers: GitHub Draft PR creation requires an authenticated maintainer session; no PR number can be truthfully reported.
A pre-existing non-task dsh-official-runtime listener owns port 3080, so Batch 016 did not drive or terminate it; current live rc.1 browser/route acceptance remains external/partial.
Both 0.2.0 packages are intentionally unpublished; registry compatibility and post-publication install remain release debt.
No authorized hosted visual-provider credential was used; real-provider quality remains open debt.
notes: README is materially shorter and retains the third-party disclaimer, architecture split, install/use/config basics, 8-image bound, cache/reliability/security boundaries, compatibility and development links.
CHANGELOG now distinguishes deterministic/build evidence from exact rc.1 source-built evidence and does not describe the unpublished candidate as a registry release.
Compatibility/release/debt docs preserve historical rows and explicitly keep provider, publication, tag/release and real-Harness authorization boundaries open.
The current source tree had no implementation defect attributable to the task-owned code during this documentation/closure run; no source change was invented to mask host or registry blockers.
ACTIVE_TASK deletion and final result stamping are the remaining completion commit actions; the branch remains unmerged.
